nodes.text: @ChrisLoesch I virtually never get sick but got sick with this HMPV going around. Daughter brought it home from huge conference in Vegas. I took HCQ right away for several days. I think it helped. But I still have that awful croupy cough and fatigued. Struggling to work. Get well soon.
